fresh_package_read_only_checks: Require terminal successful root-owned native build log plus CABI pack guard compatible=1 and Codex workload verified. A cargo compile success alone is insufficient.
Hash fresh module.stripped.o (or module.assets.o if embedding assets), compare artifact.elf_sha256; hash dist/codex.bp and compare receipt.blueprint_sha256.
Run readelf -W --symbols on the actual packaged module and require three GLOBAL UND workload hooks with no definitions; enumerate every actual undefined import, including non-CABI names.

Reject loader-blocked pthread lifecycle, POSIX directory streams, legacy trueos_tokio_tls_current_slot, trueos_gl_get_proc_address, trueos_cabi_fs_* and trueos_cabi_trueosfs_* imports as SDK abi_guard does.

Compare all actual trueos_cabi_* imports against both current normalized declaration maps and complete kernel lock; intersect actual imports with sdk_only_retired_kernel_names and require empty result.

For target-kernel loadability, find exact generated_portal_imports.rs selected by the kernel artifact build, verify every actual CABI import has a resolver arm, bind resolver hash and kernel image hash. Newest-file selection or matching declarations alone is insufficient.
Parse 24-byte TRBP v1 header, verify payload/raw lengths, LZ4 tar payload module.elf bytes hash equals packaged module/receipt, and executable _start/entry section-offset hint matches actual ELF.
Crosscheck ELF machine/class/endian/relocatable type, supported relocation classes and write bounds using current kernel loader contract.

Rehash all nine workload sources, verify exact canonical manifests and versions; bind fresh success-stamp outputs and mission source baseline. Do not reuse old October/November 5 receipt claims for parity.
